about: The 24/7 title's changes outside a match: backstage, at ringside, at house shows and away from any show. Each is listed by at least two of Wikipedia's List of WWE 24/7 Champions, Duncan and Will's title history and WWE.com's. A change on a show we carry names its event and an order between that show's matches. Built by lineup-check/title_247.py.
